page_title: PAR 1-1 NAP | Parma v Napoli 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
90+2' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
87' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' Alisson Santos (Napoli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
84' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
84' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Eljif Elmas (Napoli) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
83' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Alessandro Circati (Parma) for his blatant foul.
83' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

82' Mandela Keita (Parma) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic stops the ball from going into the top of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Parma.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matteo Politano as he is replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
78' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eljif Elmas (Napoli) replacing Kevin De Bruyne.
78' Alisson Santos (Napoli) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
77' Christian Ordonez (Parma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
77' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emanuele Valeri (Parma). Good work from Parma as they win a corner.

75' Scott McTominay (Napoli) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Zion Suzuki shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
75' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
75' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
74' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick. Parma are awarded the free kick.
72' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Daniel Mikolajewski.
71' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.

71' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Parma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
69' Alisson Santos (Napoli) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
68' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
68' Alisson Santos (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Ordonez (Parma) comes onto the pitch so that Adrian Bernabe Garcia can be given a rest.
66' Here is a change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Nahuel Estevez (Parma).
66' Giovane (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rasmus Hojlund.

65' Great solo effort by Alisson Santos (Napoli) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
65' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
64' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:3. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:11.

60' 1 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund displays great vision and sends a pass to Scott McTominay (Napoli), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 1:1.
59' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Nesta Elphege and he is replaced by Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
59' Surely that's handball by one of the Parma players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
56' It is time for a substitution. Alisson Santos (Napoli) is on for Frank Anguissa.
55' Scott McTominay (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just over the bar.
51' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Antonio Conte makes a half-time substitution. Sam Beukema (Napoli) comes on in place of Juan Jesus.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Di Bello starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Juan Jesus (Napoli) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
44' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

44' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Scott McTominay (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
41' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle as Scott McTominay (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
41' Leonardo Spinazzola plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.
37' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is flagged for offside.
36' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) attempts to find Rasmus Hojlund, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
35' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
33' The game is interrupted now, Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
31' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
31' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
29' Matteo Politano (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

29' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
25' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. Parma win a free kick.
24' Nesta Elphege (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle. Napoli earn a free kick.
23' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Leonardo Spinazzola, but Zion Suzuki displays great awareness to stop him.
21' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
19' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
18' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Emanuele Valeri (Parma) brought his opponent down. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. Parma have a free kick.
13' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
11' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
9' Nesta Elphege (Parma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Nesta Elphege (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' An attempted cross from Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is cleared.
6' He should have scored! Scott McTominay (Napoli) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
5' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

1' 1 - 0 Nesta Elphege produces a killer pass to release Gabriel Strefezza (Parma), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 1:0!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Di Bello.
